gui.guhs.safari.bus.chauffeur.hallo: Hello, vads! I'm Toeter, driver of the Guh Safari Bus. It's free and it's yellow. Fancy a ride to Safari Park Vadse Bergen?
gui.guhs.safari.bus.chauffeur.straks.ant: Fine, I'll wait here. I still have a nibble anyway.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.instappen: You get on the Guh Safari Bus...
gui.guhs.safari.bus.storing: The bus won't start. Try again in a moment, njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.al_bezig: Hold on, you're already watching a scene.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.guhs_mee: %s of your guhs ride along on the roof.
gui.guhs.safari.bus.niet_bouwen: This bus station belongs to everyone: no breaking or building here.
commands.guhs.safari.busstation.nee: No bus station fits here (too steep or no room). Try a flatter spot.
commands.guhs.safari.busstation.geen: No bus station found within %s blocks.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.titel: By Guh Safari Bus to the park
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.weg: Seatbelts on, snout forward! Off we go, vads!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.savanne: Smell that? That's the savanna. Or my lunch. Both tasty.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.zebra: Njeg, hold on! Zebras always have right of way.
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.poort: Look, the elephant gate! Welcome to Safari Park Vadse Bergen!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.uitstappen: Last stop! Get off on the cuddly side. Have fun, and don't feed the animals without asking!
scene.guhs.safari_bus_heen_0.grap: Do you know why the zebra has stripes? So it doesn't get lost in the barcode shop. Njeg.
